summary: Confirmed reuse of exact existing profileAt/edgePairOf via unchanged accepted composition/source-pixel adapter for one long profile versus consecutive short profiles. Existing Python tracker/follower and native ridge continuity routing were inspected and must not be duplicated. Only new frozen-request orchestration and receipt-only long/short comparison reporting are needed; physical cross-window edge association remains UNKNOWN, not implemented or inferred.
confirmedReuse: Platform pathSpace.mjs blob38963d20f7a8b7c7851b3a2abea2e472da8f7716 is byte-identical to the vendored Lab source. Algorithm head lacks that port; do not pretend both branches supply it.
Existing composition stations array already retains raw profiles, counts, total stations, exact nominal-width fit fields, nulls and average-pair midpoint for arbitrary declared nonempty windows.
Existing source-pixel adapter verifies strict support and unchanged recipe closure, and keeps paired crop/original-zoom comparisons. No adapter or fitter edit needed.
Existing stationContrastAt/lossAt provide optional finer visibility/gap diagnostics if separately approved; no duplicate pixel or gap mathematics necessary.
missingSeams: New premeasurement caller request binding long/short windows, controls, source, original zoom geometry, falsifier and support envelope.
Receipt-only comparison table/figure with all short windows including nulls, visibility failures and unchanged controls.

No existing inspected API authenticates same physical edge pair across windows. Descriptive raw changes can be reported with association UNKNOWN; new inference thresholds would expand capability scope.
criticalLimitations: edgePairOf requires ok>=max(8,.2*nT) and >=.6 good offsets; fewer than eight sample stations necessarily null under existing defaults. Do not weaken minOk to make a short trial fit.
A fitted long average cannot establish bilateral continuity at each station. Per-offset visibility counts do not establish per-station bilateral visibility.
Four-lane channels depend on station pose, not t0/t1; with common pose and changed windows these repeat and must not be described as new longitudinal evidence.
follow.residuals already computes rolling short-window fits but drops nulls and raw profiles/counts; do not use its successful-pairs-only output as the falsifier receipt.
No fresh width calibration, global classifier, alpha benefit, endpoint ownership, held-out truth or scientific acceptance follows.
